title: Pointwise etaleness is preserved and reflected by field extension
statement: Let k be a field, K/k a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], and f:X\to Y a morphism of k-schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-pc-morphism-conventions], with base change f_K:X_K\to Y_K along \operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}k [def-pc-base-change]. For every point x\in X and every point x_K\in X_K above x, f is etale at x (etale on an open neighbourhood of x [def-weil-etale-morphism]) if and only if f_K is etale at x_K.

source.place: Varieties, Lemma Tag 0C4Y (lemma-change-fields-flat: O_{X,x} -> O_{X_K,x_K} faithfully flat) with Descent, Lemma Tag 02VN (lemma-descending-property-etale) and Tag 036N (lemma-locally-finite-presentation-fppf-local-source); the tags 02H5/02H6 given before are unrelated (first order thickenings, infinitesimal lifting)

proof.text: If f is etale at x, choose an open neighbourhood U of x on which f|U is etale. The base change U_K \to Y_K is etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-scheme-base-change], so f_K is etale at x_K.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma Tag 02GO (base change of etale morphisms)

proof.text: Conversely, suppose f_K is etale at x_K. By Varieties, Tag 0C4Y the local map \mathcal{O}_{X,x}\to\mathcal{O}_{X_K,x_K} is faithfully flat, and etaleness at x_K descends along this field-extension base change to etaleness of f at x; this pointwise descent statement is exactly [lem-sc-etale-faithfully-flat-local], applied to the same k, K, f, x and x_K. (The global descent of etaleness along an fpqc covering, Descent Tag 02VN, does not by itself give the pointwise statement, and Tag 036N concerns fppf coverings, which \operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}k need not be.)

source.place: Varieties, Tag 0C4Y (faithful flatness of \mathcal{O}_{X,x}\to\mathcal{O}_{X_K,x_K}); pointwise analogue of Descent, Tag 02VN

lean.statement: theorem etaleAt_iff_fieldExtension (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] {X Y : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X.left) (xK : (pullback X.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme)) (hx : (pullback.fst X.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))) xK = x) : (∃ U : X.left.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ Etale (U.ι ≫ f.left)) ↔ (let fK := ((Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).map f).left ∃ U : (pullback X.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).Opens, xK ∈ U ∧ Etale (U.ι ≫ fK))

reviewed_lean.note: k K Type u fields with Algebra k K = K/k; X Y : Over (Spec k) and f : X ⟶ Y = morphism of k-schemes (bundled form); X_K = Limits.pullback X.hom (Spec.map algebraMap), fK = (Over.pullback g).map f .left, checked rfl-equal to pullback.map f.left id id; xK above x via pullback.fst = f_T; étale at a point = ∃ open U ∋ x, Etale (U.ι ≫ f) on both sides, iff for every x and xK; no extra finiteness/char hypotheses; docstring follows both proof steps; pullback resolves to CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback
